**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Gaza war]]
****Eight [[Palestinian Civil Police Force (Hamas)|police officers]], including the police chief of the [[Deir al-Balah Governorate]], are killed by an [[Israel]]i attack on a police vehicle in [[Az-Zawayda]], [[Palestine]]. ***[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Gaza war]]

***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
****An [[Italian Armed Forces|Italian]] [[General Atomics MQ-9 Reaper|MQ-9 Reaper]] is destroyed in an [[Iran]]ian [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drone strike]] on [[Ali Al Salem Air Base]] in [[Kuwait]]. [https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/mondo/2026/03/15/drone-colpisce-una-base-italiana-in-kuwait-distrutto-un-velivolo.-resta-solo_57ae8dae-30c3-4376-8341-e7bab885c020.html (ANSA)]
*[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
**[[Afghan Armed Forces|Afghan forces]] launch [[Mortar (weapon)|mortar]]s into [[Pakistan]], with one hitting a residential property in [[Bajaur District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], killing four members of the same family and wounding two others. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/mar/15/pakistan-targets-militant-hideouts-afghanistan-conflict (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Jonglei clashes (2025–present)|Jonglei clashes]]
**The [[South Sudan People's Defence Forces]] announces that they have deployed troops in [[Akobo, South Sudan|Akobo]], [[South Sudan]] to secure full control of the area for the first time since the outbreak of the [[South Sudanese Civil War|civil war]] in the country after having previously recapturing the area from [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement-in-Opposition|opposition forces]]. [https://medafricatimes.com/44466-south-sudan-army-reclaims-strategic-akobo-town-after-years-of-conflict.html (''Medafrica Times'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[98th Academy Awards]]
**At the [[Academy Awards]], ''[[One Battle After Another]]'' wins six [[Academy Awards]], including [[Academy Award for Best Picture|Best Picture]] and the inaugural [[Academy Award for Achievement in Casting|Achievement in Casting]] award. [https://apnews.com/live/oscars-2026-updates (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/oscars-top-prize-up-grabs-unease-hangs-over-hollywood-2026-03-15/ (Reuters)]
**''[[Sinners (2025 film)|Sinners]]'' wins four Academy Awards following a [[List of Academy Award records|record]] 16 nominations, with [[Ryan Coogler]] for [[Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay|original screenplay]], [[Michael B. Jordan]] for [[Academy Award for Best Actor|lead actor]], [[Autumn Durald Arkapaw]] for [[Academy Award for Best Cinematography|cinematography]], and [[Ludwig Göransson]] for [[Academy Award for Best Original Score|score]]. [https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/sinners-wins-four-oscars-record-16-nominations-1236533090/ (''The Hollywood Reporter'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[Japan]] announces it will start releasing 80 million [[Barrel (unit)|barrel]]s of [[crude oil|oil]] from [[Global strategic petroleum reserves#Japan|its reserves]], the largest such release in the country's history, in response to disruptions in the oil supply caused by the conflict. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/japan-release-oil-stocks-us-says-buy-american-2026-03-15/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Kenya floods]]
**The death toll from [[severe weather|severe]] [[flood]]ing in [[Kenya]] rises to 66, according to the [[Kenya Red Cross Society]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz6e5eng03yo (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Kent meningitis outbreak]]
**Two people are killed and eleven others are hospitalized in serious condition following a [[meningitis]] outbreak at the [[University of Kent]] in [[Canterbury]], [[Kent, England|Kent]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdxg35dv7npo (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 French municipal elections]]
**The first round of municipal elections takes place in [[France]]. [https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/the-first-round-of-municipal-elections-in-france/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjY6bmV3c21sX1JDMjE1S0ExUEhHVQ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Kazakh constitutional referendum]]
**[[Kazakhstanis]] vote in a referendum to approve a new [[Constitution of Kazakhstan|constitution]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kazakhs-vote-new-constitution-referendum-sunday-2026-03-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 North Korean parliamentary election]]
**[[North Koreans]] vote to elect the 687 members of the [[Supreme People's Assembly|15th Supreme People's Assembly]]. [https://thediplomat.com/2026/03/a-primer-on-north-koreas-upcoming-parliamentary-election/ (''The Diplomat'')]
*[[2026 Republic of the Congo presidential election]]
**[[Demographics of the Republic of the Congo|Congolese people]] vote to elect a [[President of the Republic of Congo|president]], with incumbent [[Denis Sassou Nguesso]] seeking a fifth consecutive term. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/incumbent-sassou-favoured-congo-republic-ballot-amid-rights-concerns-2026-03-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Vietnamese legislative election]]
**[[Demographics of Vietnam|Vietnamese citizens]] vote to elect the 500 members of the [[National Assembly of Vietnam|16th National Assembly]]. The sole legal party contesting the election is the [[Communist Party of Vietnam|Communist Party]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/communist-party-fields-nearly-93-candidates-vietnam-holds-parliament-elections-2026-03-15/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 Winter Paralympics]]
**[[2026 Winter Paralympics closing ceremony]]
***The [[Winter Paralympics]] conclude in [[Cortina d'Ampezzo]], [[Italy]], with [[China at the 2026 Winter Paralympics|China]] as the highest-ranked team in the [[2026 Winter Paralympics medal table|medal table]]. The [[Paralympic flag]] is handed over to the organizers of the [[2030 Winter Paralympics]] to be held in the [[French Alps]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260315-milan-cortina-paralympics-end-as-a-beacon-of-unity (AFP via France 24)]
**In [[Para ice hockey at the 2026 Winter Paralympics|para ice hockey]], the [[United States men's national ice sledge hockey team|United States]] defeats [[Canada men's national para ice hockey team|Canada]] 6–2, completing the [[three-peat]] of hockey championships at the [[Winter Olympics]] and [[Winter Paralympic Games|Paralympics]] in [[Italy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/paralympics-ice-hockey-united-states-canada-final-eba8092d12b64fe0b61f49406af322ba (AP)]
*[[2026 Formula One World Championship]]
**[[2026 Chinese Grand Prix]]
***In [[auto racing]], [[Mercedes-Benz in Formula One|Mercedes-Benz]] driver [[Kimi Antonelli]] wins his first [[Formula One]] [[List of Formula One Grand Prix winners|Grand Prix]] after also setting his maiden [[pole position]] at the 2026 [[Chinese Grand Prix]]. He becomes the [[List_of_Formula_One_driver_records#Youngest_winners|second-youngest Grand Prix winner]] at 19 years old. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260315-emotional-antonelli-wins-maiden-grand-prix-with-mercedes-1-2-in-china (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[Iran at the FIFA World Cup]]
***[[Asian Football Confederation]] secretary general [[Windsor John]] says that the [[Iran national football team]] will still play at the upcoming [[FIFA World Cup]] despite remarks from [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] that their safety could be at risk. [https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/iran-world-cup-usa-trump-warning-b2939654.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[2026 FC Barcelona presidential election]]
**In [[association football]], [[Joan Laporta]] is re-elected [[president of FC Barcelona|president]] of [[FC Barcelona]]. [https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/48217463/joan-laporta-re-elected-barcelona-president-landslide (ESPN)]
